from.place: Noetherian approximation proof step: descent of the bounded finitely presented flat complex (Tags 01ZR and 05LY)

title: Descent of a bounded finitely presented flat complex
statement: Let I be a directed set and let (S_i)_{i\in I} be an inverse system of quasi-compact, quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms, where S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R_i) for Noetherian rings R_i, and let S=\varprojlim_i S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R). Let X_i be a finitely presented S_i-scheme [def-pc-scheme] and write X=X_i\times_{S_i}S. Let G^\bullet be a bounded complex of finitely presented \mathcal{O}_X-modules flat over S [def-pc-morphism-conventions, def-pc-base-change]. Then there are j\geq i and a bounded complex G_j^\bullet of finitely presented \mathcal{O}_{X_j}-modules flat over S_j, where X_j=X_i\times_{S_i}S_j, together with an isomorphism from its base change to G^\bullet.

proof.text: Apply bounded finite-presentation descent to the finite range of terms of G^\bullet and to all differentials and relations between them. After increasing the stage, obtain a bounded complex H_j^\bullet of finitely presented \mathcal{O}_{X_j}-modules with base-change isomorphism H_j^\bullet\otimes_{S_j}S\cong G^\bullet.

For each degree r in the finite bounded range, the term H_j^r is a finitely presented quasi-coherent \mathcal{O}_{X_j}-module whose pullback to X is isomorphic (step 1) to G^r, hence flat over S; eventual flatness descent applied to H_j^r (with j as the starting stage) gives a stage j_r\ge j such that the pullback of H_j^r to X_{j'} is flat over S_{j'} for every j'\ge j_r. A zero term is already flat. There are finitely many degrees, so directedness gives one stage j' above all j_r, at which every pulled-back term is flat over S_{j'}. Base-changing the whole complex H_j^\bullet from j to j' preserves its differentials, boundedness, finite presentation, and the chosen identification with G^\bullet.

Rename the common later stage j' as j and the base-changed complex as G_j^\bullet. It is bounded, termwise finitely presented and flat over S_j, and its base change to X is isomorphic to G^\bullet, as required.

lean.statement: theorem flat_bounded_complex_descent {I : Type u} [PartialOrder I] [IsDirectedOrder I] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ k : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj k)] (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt] (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (G : CochainComplex (pullback f (c.π.app (op i))).Modules ℤ) (hG_bounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (G.X n)) (hG_fp : ∀ n : ℤ, (G.X n).IsFinitePresentation) (hG_flat : ∀ n : ℤ, (G.X n).IsFlatOver (pullback.snd f (c.π.app (op i)))) : ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j) (Gj : CochainComplex (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Modules ℤ), (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (Gj.X n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, (Gj.X n).IsFinitePresentation) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, (Gj.X n).IsFlatOver (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))) ∧ ∃ e : ∀ n : ℤ, (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))) (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i))) (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj (Gj.X n) ≅ G.X n, ∀ n m : ℤ, (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))) (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i))) (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).map (Gj.d n m) ≫ (e m).hom = (e n).hom ≫ G.d n m
